breath_text: The ABP just opened a 2-year fellowship path in 7 subspecialties for programs that can show readiness with EPAs. That makes trustworthy assessment data priceless, and a JGME study finds AI summaries of rotation comments catch most strengths but miss most areas for improvement. On the recruitment side, signals dominate who gets an interview, and a small PHM pilot shows how far a structured mentoring cohort can move confidence.

calendar.text: APPD Spring ELS proposals and PAS 2027 abstracts due.

top.headline: Can ChatGPT prep your CCC packet? It finds the praise and misses the critique
bullets: 277 end-of-rotation assessments for 25 residents: de-identifying took ~60 min, and 3 LLMs labeled the comments in under 7 min each.

Humans found 476 comments (81.5% strengths, 18.5% areas for improvement). LLM recall was 67.8% for strengths but only 23.9% for areas for improvement; 59.7% of comments were labeled accurately overall.
top.tip: the comments a CCC most needs are the ones the models missed. Let AI compile, but have a human read every constructive comment.
top.citation: Cooney CM, Slattery R, Cooney DS, Lifchez SD, Park JE. J Grad Med Educ. Aug 2026. PMID 42602997. doi:10.4300/JGME-D-25-01049.1

top.headline: Signals rule the interview list, and gold signals rule most of all
bullets: ERAS 2023-24 data from 6 specialties (peds not included): a signal raised interview odds 4.7-7.4x with few signals, 8.4-18.5x with many, and up to 55-218x for gold signals in 2-tier systems.
Step 2 CK, never failing Step 1, applicant type, and in-state status also mattered, but less. Signals helped out-of-state applicants most.
top.tip: peds invites can go out Oct 5. Before you screen, agree as a committee on how much a signal should weigh so it's applied consistently.
top.citation: Guthrie ST, Griffith B, Hammoud MM, et al. Acad Med. Online Aug 3, 2026. doi:10.1093/acamed/wvag206

top.headline: SHINE: six hours that grew early-career PHM women's mentor networks
bullets: A 2025 national pilot for trainee and early-career women in PHM: six 1-hour sessions on negotiation, job search, promotion, branding, and mentorship.
25 participants (16 matched pre-post pairs): confidence rose in all 12 career domains (Cohen's d 1.06-2.11). Cross-institutional mentors went from 36% to 67%, peer mentors from 12% to 100%.
top.tip: a light-touch cohort model is easy to borrow for chiefs or PHM fellows. Caveats: small, self-reported, no control group.
top.citation: "Evaluation of a National Mentorship Pilot Program for Early-Career Women in PHM." Hosp Pediatr. Online Sept 14, 2026. PMID 42732884. doi:10.1542/hpeds.2026-009354

news.text: ABP opens a 2-year fellowship path. Starting with fellows who enter in July 2028, programs in 7 subspecialties (adolescent medicine, DBP, PEM, endocrinology, ID, nephrology, rheumatology) can petition for a 2-year clinically focused track. They need EPA-based CBME and must extend training for any fellow not ready at 24 months. Applications open early 2027.
ACGME renames "complaints." They're now "Non-Compliance Reports," with the same purpose and review process. There's also new free microlearning on direct observation (0.25-0.5 CME).

acadpeds.text: Dual language learners. Of 349 pediatric providers, 79% struggled to spot language delays in DLLs when they didn't share the family's language (vs 7% for monolingual kids). Bilingualism training went with more culturally effective care.

The P-CASH scale. A new 3-factor confidence scale (141 providers; alpha 0.90-0.95) found pediatric providers less confident than non-pediatric providers in adolescent sexual health on all 3 subscales.
"Diagnosing the Trainee in Difficulty." From the APPD Faculty and Professional Development Task Force. Title only; it's a discussion piece with no abstract.

quick.text: Handoff as ritual: 14 EM residents described group handoff as a ritual that builds community, norms, and hierarchy, not just a way to pass information. Zvonar I, et al. Acad Med, online Aug 13.
Academic Advocacy Guidelines in Pediatrics. Black AK, Pulcini CD, et al. Pediatrics, Sept 18. Title only; no abstract in PubMed.
